{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}')
print('\nQA order examples:')
print(qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue', 'converted']].head())

# Filter out QA orders
filtered_sales = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Now filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = filtered_sales[
    (filtered_sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (filtered_sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print result and count
print(f'\nMean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers: {mean_revenue}')
print(f'Number of loyal, completed orders after filtering QA rows: {len(loyal_completed)}')"}
